title: Pool every server-side Sweed RPC (maintenance.ts + liveRecentSales.ts)
description: Replace the private callSweedRpcRaw + getServerEnv().sweedAuthToken paths in src/server/catalog/maintenance.ts and src/server/catalog/liveRecentSales.ts with the worker's pooled client. Every Sweed RPC originating from server code must run inside an active withSweedSession() block so it leases a token from sweed_session_tokens and releases it on completion. Delete the module-local runInSweedWriteBatch / withSweedSessionLock / sweedWriteDealerId machinery — session.ts's per-token dealer cache plus empty-pool deferral handle both serialization concerns. After this change, getServerEnv().sweedAuthToken is no longer referenced from src/server/** and a smoke barcode edit succeeds using a pool token (verifiable via sweed_auth_events tagged with the pool row id, not the env token).

title: PendingMaintenanceImageStore + local-fs implementation
description: Add src/server/catalog/pendingImageUploadStore.ts exporting PendingImageUploadStore { put(bytes, mime, meta) -> { stagedRef }; read(stagedRef) -> { bytes, mime, meta }; delete(stagedRef); listOlderThan(date) }. Ship a LocalFsPendingImageUploadStore writing to ${HELIOS_STATE_DIR:-/var/lib/helios}/pending-image-uploads/{uuid}.{ext} plus a sibling .meta.json (groupId, sweedGroupId, requestedByUserId, targetType, originalFilename, createdAt). Backend selection via env var HELIOS_PENDING_UPLOAD_BACKEND (default 'fs'). S3 impl is a follow-on (Phase 7) gated on operator providing bucket + creds.

title: Worker job catalog.maintenance.upload_group_image
description: Add CatalogMaintenanceUploadGroupImageJobPayloadSchema to src/shared/contracts/domain/jobs.ts ({ stagedRef, groupId, sweedGroupId, requestedByUserId, trigger }). Implement src/worker/jobs/catalogMaintenanceUploadGroupImageJob.ts: reads bytes via PendingImageUploadStore, calls store.blob.add, PUTs bytes, fetches group.get, computes nextImageIds, calls store.product.group.edit, re-fetches group.get to verify the new blobId is attached (HTTP 502 if not), flags the group for reanalysis, invalidates the maintenance survey cache, deletes the staged file. Register in src/worker/runtime/jobRegistry.ts handlers map, add to SWEED_BACKED_JOB_TYPES so the runner wraps the handler in withSweedSession(), and map to the 'sweed' pool in src/worker/runtime/jobPools.ts. Report per-step progress via payload_json.progress so /api/jobs/:id is meaningful for the UI.

title: Refactor POST /api/catalog/maintenance/images to enqueue + return job id
description: Update src/server/routes/catalogMaintenance.ts: validate multipart bytes/mime, stash via PendingImageUploadStore, enqueueJob('catalog.maintenance.upload_group_image', payload, { priority: JOB_PRIORITY_HIGH }), respond { status: 'queued', jobId, stagedRef, groupId, targetType }. Reject targetType === 'variants' with HTTP 410 Gone + a message pointing at the parked variant work. Delete the synchronous uploadCatalogMaintenanceImage() function (no other callers), along with its supporting plumbing in maintenance.ts (createBlob, putBlobBytes, fetchGroupImagesWithinLock, runInSweedWriteBatch). Update CatalogMaintenanceUploadResultSchema in src/shared/contracts/index.ts to match the new shape.

title: UI: per-card queued + polling status + Retry
description: In src/client (catalog maintenance page), the per-card upload action now POSTs and receives { status: 'queued', jobId, stagedRef }. The card banner moves through queued (job #N) -> running step N/M -> ✓ uploaded (then re-fetch survey to clear the card) or ✗ failed: <reason> with a Retry button. Status polling reuses /api/jobs/:id (1-2 second interval, exponential backoff after 30s). Retry POSTs to a new endpoint POST /api/catalog/maintenance/images/:stagedRef/retry which simply re-enqueues the same payload (no re-upload). Banner shows 'waiting for Sweed session pool' explicitly when /api/jobs/:id reports the job is deferred by DependencyUnavailableWorkerError so operators understand why the work isn't running.

title: Staging GC job catalog.maintenance.upload_gc
description: Tiny periodic worker job enqueued every hour from src/worker/runtime/configWorkersScheduler.ts that lists staged refs older than 7 days via PendingImageUploadStore.listOlderThan(7d), drops any whose corresponding job is in terminal state (succeeded|failed_permanent) or whose job row no longer exists. Surfaces orphan-staged counts in worker metrics so we notice if GC stops running. Add a payload schema + handler + entry in jobRegistry + jobPools (system pool, not sweed-backed).

title: S3 backend for PendingImageUploadStore (follow-on, needs operator input)
description: Blocked on operator confirming: which S3 bucket name + region, which agenix-managed credentials. Once unblocked: add @aws-sdk/client-s3 to package.json, implement S3PendingImageUploadStore reading HELIOS_PENDING_UPLOAD_S3_BUCKET / _REGION / _KEY_PREFIX. Backend selected via HELIOS_PENDING_UPLOAD_BACKEND={fs|s3}. Local-fs remains the default until the operator opts in. Migration plan: drain the local-fs queue first, switch the env var, restart helios-server + helios-worker.

title: Runbook + cleanup
description: Write docs/helios/catalog-maintenance-pooled-async-uploads/RUNBOOK.md covering: inspecting staged uploads on disk, manually re-enqueueing a stalled job, draining the pending dir after a hardware swap, reading the per-card status banner, recognising pool-exhausted vs auth-expired vs Sweed-rejected failures. Drop SWEED_AUTH_TOKEN from src/server/config/env.ts schema (worker keeps it as a legacy fallback for now). Cross-link this epic from docs/helios/catalog-maintenance/EPIC_PLAN.md as the resilience follow-on.
